serviceDetails.name: Drafting Legal Documents
serviceDetails.description: This service facilitates the drafting of various legal documents (such as contracts, memorandums, affidavits, agreements, etc.) requested by private individuals, external entities, or the various offices within the Local Government Unit (LGU). The drafting process ensures that all terms, stipulations, and directives are clearly articulated, legally sound, supported by necessary factual details, and strictly compliant with the Local Government Code and other pertinent national and local laws. Once drafted and verified, the document is forwarded to the respective client who requested such document.

requirements.name: Duly Filled out Request Form

steps.clientStep: Obtain request form for drafting an Legal Documents and fill it out with complete details and then submit it to the clerical staff.
agencyAction: 1.1 Review the Completeness of the form and make sure no sections are blank
1.2 Accurately log the request in the Logbook upon Review of Completeness
1.3 If the request form is duly filled out and is then logged, forward the Request to the Municipal Administrator for the start of the Initial Drafting
1.4 Upon the final draft of the Legal Document, forward it to the requester along with the attached request form

steps.clientStep: Sign the request form to signify completion of the task and receive the finalized draft.
agencyAction: 2. Have the request form duly signed by the requester indicating the date and time it had been completed and received

serviceDetails.name: Providing Legal Advice
serviceDetails.description: This service facilitates the provision of legal counsel, formal opinions, and guidance, including personal, face-to-face consultations provided directly to the general public, private individuals, external entities, or the various offices within the Local Government Unit (LGU). The advisory process ensures that all legal interpretations, recommendations, and guidance are clearly articulated, legally sound, supported by a thorough assessment of factual details, and strictly compliant with the Local Government Code, relevant jurisprudence, and other pertinent national and local laws. Once formulated and verified, the legal advice or formal written opinion is personally relayed or forwarded to the respective client or office who requested the assistance to guide their decision-making and ensure lawful actions.

The processing workflow ensures that all received letters are properly assessed, attached with official action slips, and endorsed with specific administrative directives such as for appropriate action, information, reference, filing, scheduling with the Mayor, official attendance, or approval of requests. Once categorized and marked with the approved routing instructions, the document is forwarded to the concerned department or personnel to ensure proper disposition, timely response, and efficient administrative execution.

serviceDetails.name: Review and Approval of Payrolls (JO, COS, and Regular Employees)
serviceDetails.description: This service facilitates the review and approval of payrolls for Job Order (JO), Contract of Service (COS), and Regular employees prepared by the various offices within the Local Government Unit (LGU). Once reviewed and verified, the payroll is forwarded to the Municipal Administrator for final approval to initiate the formal processing and timely disbursement of salaries and wages.

steps.clientStep: Await possible schedule of field or area visitation (if deemed necessary).

steps.clientStep: Receive recommendation or technical advice on pest/disease management and control measures.
agencyAction: 4. Provide technical recommendations or interventions based on findings and available program assistance.

agencyAction: 5. Release the signed Certification for Non-Productive Fruit Trees upon approval of the Municipal Agriculturist.

serviceDetails.name: Cancellation of Real Property
serviceDetails.description: Cancellation of a Real Property Declaration refers to the formal removal or invalidation of a property's declaration from official assessment or tax records. serviceDetails.name: Admission of Patients (Emergency Room)
serviceDetails.description: This process provides immediate and life-saving medical care to patients requiring urgent attention.
serviceDetails.office: Renato Umali Reyes Hospital – Emergency Room

steps.clientStep: Follow instructions and cooperate with the Nurse on Duty. Consent to examination, laboratory/x-ray if necessary, or doctor's assessment.
agencyAction: I. TRIAGE: 1.1 Assess the patient, gather essential information, and obtain vital signs.
1.2 Classify the patient according to the level of emergency.
1.3 Explain to the patient or relatives the prioritization of patients with more critical conditions. (Classification: 1-Immediately, 2-10 minutes, 3-30 minutes, 4-60 minutes, 5-2 hours)

steps.clientStep: Follow instructions and cooperate with the Nurse on Duty.
agencyAction: II. HISTORY TAKING AND PHYSICAL EXAM: 2.1 Documentation and gathering of the patient's medical history.
2.2 Conduct of comprehensive physical examination of the patient.
2.3 Formulation of initial diagnosis.

steps.clientStep: Follow instructions and cooperate with the Nurse on Duty.
agencyAction: III. EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT: 3. Administration of initial medication (emergency treatment/first aid), documentation of medications administered, and implementation of the doctor's orders.

steps.clientStep: Follow instructions and cooperate with the Nurse on Duty.
agencyAction: IV. ADMISSION: 4.1 Explain to the patient and relatives the reason for admission, and complete the Doctor's Orders and the History and Physical Examination Form.
4.2 The Nurse on Duty will carry out the Doctor's Order, and complete the Nurse's Notes and the patient chart.
4.3 Complete inpatient admission.

offices.name: Internal Audit Unit
internalServices: Compliance Audit, Management Audit, and Operations Audit

serviceDetails.name: Compliance Audit, Management Audit, and Operations Audit
serviceDetails.description: Compliance audit is the evaluation of the degree of compliance of controls with laws, regulations, managerial policies, and operating procedures in the LGU, including compliance with accountability measures, ethical standards, and contractual obligations. Management audit is a separate evaluation of the effectiveness of internal controls adopted in the operating and support service units/systems. Operations audit is a separate evaluation of the outcome, output, process, and input to determine whether or not government operations, programs, and projects are 4Es.
serviceDetails.classification: Simple, Complex or Highly Technical (may vary per project)
serviceDetails.whoMayAvail: All offices/departments of the Local Government Unit of Bongabong

requirements.name: Endorsement Letter with action slip from the Office of the Municipal Mayor

steps.clientStep: Submit the endorsement letter/written instructions from the Mayor to the Internal Audit Service's office.
agencyAction: 1.0 Receive the Endorsement Letter with Action Slip from the Mayor's Office.
1.2 Conduct preliminary review to determine if the audit request is within the scope of the IAS.
personsResponsible: Diane E. Salvador, Mae Karen M. Delacion (Office Clerk)

steps.clientStep: Wait for the evaluation result or feedback from the Internal Auditor III regarding the audit request.
agencyAction: 1.3 If the audit request is NOT within the scope of IAS: 1.3.1 Prepare and issue a Declining letter with justification citing COA and DBM guidelines.
1.3.2 Furnish the Declining Letter to the requesting party and copy furnished to the Municipal Mayor.
personsResponsible: Diane E. Salvador, Mae Karen M. Delacion (Office Clerk)

steps.clientStep: Receive official response from the Internal Auditor III. (If declined, receive formal communication explaining why the audit request was declined.)
agencyAction: 1.3.2.2 If within the scope of IAS: Prepare the Audit Notification letter.
1.3.2.3 Issue the notification letter to the concerned office and conduct dialogue as to the scope and objectives of the audit.
personsResponsible: Diane E. Salvador, Mae Karen M. Delacion (Office Clerk)

steps.clientStep: Participate in the conduct of Compliance Audit by providing requested documents, information and access to relevant records.
agencyAction: 2.2.3 Conduct Compliance Audit in accordance with DBM Internal Audit procedures, focusing on adherence to laws, rules, regulations and internal policies.

2.2.4 Draft the Audit Observation Memorandum (AOM) summarizing audit findings, observations and preliminary recommendations, and finalize the audit report in preparation for submission to the audited office.
personsResponsible: Diane E. Salvador, Mae Karen M. Delacion (Office Clerk)

steps.clientStep: Review or acknowledge the draft Audit Observation Memorandum (AOM) submitted by the Internal Audit Service.
agencyAction: 2.2.5 Issue the Audit Observation Memorandum (AOM) to the audited office and furnish a copy to the Municipal Mayor in accordance with DBM Internal Audit procedures.

steps.clientStep: Receive the Audit Observation Memorandum (AOM) containing audit findings and preliminary recommendations from the Internal Audit Service.
agencyAction: 2.2.6 Conduct Exit Conference to clarify findings, agree on corrective actions and discuss timelines.

steps.clientStep: Participate in the Exit Conference to discuss findings and preliminary recommendations.
Submit Management Action Plan (MAP) and supporting evidence of corrective actions to the Internal Audit Service.
agencyAction: 3.1 Conduct validation and follow-through review of the submitted Management Action Plan (MAP) and supporting documents.
3.2 Prepare and issue the Audit Closure Report or Compliance Status Report based on the validated management actions.
personsResponsible: Diane E. Salvador, Mae Karen M. Delacion (Office Clerk)

steps.clientStep: Await the issuance of the Audit Closure Report or Compliance Status Notification from the Internal Audit Service.

steps.clientStep: Submit a Request Letter addressed to the Municipal Mayor, through the LEDIPO Designate expressing intent to participate in the training.
agencyAction: 1.1 Receive and record all Request Letters from interested applicants.
1.2 Prepare, gather data for supplies and materials and encode the Activity Design of the training.
1.3 Submit the Activity Design to the concerned offices for review and signature.
1.3.1 MPDO – Review and evaluate the Activity Design to ensure alignment with municipal plans and development priorities. Provide comments, recommendations, and affix signature.
1.3.2 Municipal Budget Office – Assess the proposed budget. Verify fund availability and issue budget clearance.
1.3.3 Municipal Accounting Office – Examine for accuracy of cost estimates and compliance with accounting rules. Certify and affix signature.
1.3.4 Municipal Treasurer's Office – Validate availability of cash and ensure proper allocation of funds. Sign to confirm financial readiness.
1.3.5 Mayor's Office – Approve and sign the document for implementation.
2.4 Prepare and encode the Purchase Request (PR) for the needed materials and supplies.
2.5 Submit the Purchase Request to the BAC Office for checking and secure the Request for Quotation (RFQ) for shopping.
2.6 Prepare and encode the Program for Orientation and facilitate the activity.

personsResponsible: Rechelle Anne S. Magsino, CPA (Municipal Accountant)
Sarah Anne Mae B. Comia (Acting Municipal Treasurer)

agencyAction: 3. Facilitate the orientation for the training.

agencyAction: 4. Facilitate the training proper.

agencyAction: 5.1 Facilitate the graduation ceremony.

steps.clientStep: Accomplish post-training evaluation forms honestly and provide constructive feedback.
agencyAction: 6.1 Review and evaluate once every quarter the implemented capacity and skills training programs through surveys, feedback forms, and interviews to assess sustainability, long-term impact, learning outcomes, relevance, and overall effectiveness.
